lean_results.borderline_note: Sits near the G3/G4 boundary because it verifies a concrete allocation algorithm and polynomial operation-count bounds, but is a STOC/SODA-style cs.GT fair-division approximation-ratio theorem rather than an engineering/learning/control algorithm.
lean_results.one_line_summary: Formalizes in Lean 4 (with Mathlib, leanchecker audit, and GPT-5/6 assistance) the 7/9-MMS allocation guarantee and polynomial search bounds of a strongly polynomial-time fair-division algorithm, omitting total RAM running-time/bit-complexity refinement.
lean_results.paradigm_evidence: docs/research/seven_ninths_mms.md states the Lean development follows CONSOLIDATED_PROOF_REVISED.pdf and STOC_re7.tex, the paper says 'Finally, we formalize and verify our main results in Lean 4' with LLM interaction, and docs/knowledge (mdblueprint) contains no SevenNinths nodes.
